artifact: CU Biology C.1.1 claim and evidence ledger

claims.claim: Living systems characteristically exhibit active self-maintenance rather than passive persistence alone.
claims.scope_or_condition: Requires operational boundary and intervention in each case.

claims.claim: One universal scalar C=A I measures biological coherence.
claims.scope_or_condition: No cross-system derivation or calibration.

claims.claim: A biological coherence profile may include viability, resilience, integration, closure, adaptive reach, continuity, and cost.
claims.scope_or_condition: Components require domain-specific measures.

claims.claim: Viability is a trajectory property and can be represented by viability kernels.
claims.scope_or_condition: Model-specific dynamics and controls.

claims.claim: Endogenous maintenance can be assessed through intervention and ablation.
claims.scope_or_condition: Confounding and collateral damage must be controlled.

claims.claim: Biological individuality is multidimensional and may be nested.
claims.scope_or_condition: Boundary, physiology, reproduction, and evolution can disagree.

claims.claim: Organism-relative stake follows from viability-bearing organization and endogenous regulation.
claims.scope_or_condition: Does not imply feeling or moral status.

claims.claim: Life violates or reverses the second law.
claims.scope_or_condition: Open-system entropy accounting applies.

claims.claim: Biological coherence equals low entropy.
claims.scope_or_condition: Entropy and functional organization are distinct.

claims.claim: Maintenance has a universal energetic lower bound proportional to coherence.
claims.scope_or_condition: Process-specific thermodynamic bounds may exist.

claims.claim: Abiogenesis is one universal phase transition.
claims.scope_or_condition: Specific models may exhibit transitions.

claims.claim: Abiogenesis can be decomposed into coupled autonomy transitions.
claims.scope_or_condition: Boundary, energy, closure, regulation, heredity, viability, evolvability.

claims.claim: Recurrence dominance is sufficient for life.
claims.scope_or_condition: Passive Markov counterexample.

claims.claim: Autocatalytic closure is relevant but not sufficient for life.
claims.scope_or_condition: Needs boundary, regulation, heredity, and/or viability.

claims.claim: Morphogenesis is multiscale control under constraints.
claims.scope_or_condition: Requires comparative causal models.

claims.claim: Transient bioelectric perturbation can alter later planarian polarity.
claims.scope_or_condition: Species-, treatment-, and timing-specific.

claims.claim: Bioelectricity is a universal anatomical master code.
claims.scope_or_condition: Requires cross-system evidence and mechanism.

claims.claim: Xenopus cell constructs display reconfigurable collective capacities.
claims.scope_or_condition: Laboratory-scaffolded; no consciousness inference.

claims.claim: Biological agency is graded.
claims.scope_or_condition: Levels need operational tests.

claims.claim: Neural tissue is necessary for every form of learning.
claims.scope_or_condition: Single-cell habituation-like learning has empirical support.

claims.claim: Basal learning implies consciousness.
claims.scope_or_condition: Requires separate consciousness criteria.

claims.claim: Fitness is identical with biological coherence.
claims.scope_or_condition: Fitness and organization can diverge across scales.

claims.claim: Selection can stabilize regulatory architectures.
claims.scope_or_condition: Conditional on costs, environments, and selection level.

claims.claim: Evolution universally increases complexity or coherence.
claims.scope_or_condition: Simplification, extinction, and parasitism are common possibilities.

claims.claim: Major transitions involve cooperation plus integration and conflict mediation.
claims.scope_or_condition: Mechanisms vary by transition.

claims.claim: Cancer can be modeled partly as local–global regulatory decoupling.
claims.scope_or_condition: Supplements rather than replaces molecular oncology.

claims.claim: Bioelectric recoupling will normalize every cancer.
claims.scope_or_condition: Evidence is model-specific.

claims.claim: Aging is contraction or reshaping of recoverable trajectories.
claims.scope_or_condition: Multidimensional and not strictly monotonic.

claims.claim: Death is C=0.
claims.scope_or_condition: Replaced by intervention-relative irrecoverable organismal failure.

claims.claim: Nonbiological systems could in principle instantiate self-maintenance and stake.
claims.scope_or_condition: Depends on architecture; not yet a claim about current LLMs.

claims.claim: Current frontier LLM instances are living organisms.
claims.scope_or_condition: Maintenance, energy, reproduction, and identity remain externally supplied.

claims.claim: Intelligence, life, consciousness, selfhood, and responsibility are distinct.
claims.scope_or_condition: To be refined in Consciousness and AI.

claims.claim: The CU profile will improve biological prediction.
claims.scope_or_condition: Must be tested against strong baselines.

claims.claim: Life is sacred.
claims.scope_or_condition: Not a biological derivation.

claims.claim: Life is matter organized so continuation becomes causally relevant to present activity.
claims.scope_or_condition: Naturalized teleonomy; no foresight implied.

claims.claim: For a unique binding component under diffusive mean coupling, the direct instantaneous contribution to minimum margin is kappa*(mean(x)-x_j).
claims.scope_or_condition: Local directional statement; does not determine global finite-trajectory monotonicity.

claims.claim: Stronger diffusive integration universally improves biological viability.
claims.scope_or_condition: Disproved by the heterogeneous-floor deterministic configuration; empirical direction remains system-specific.

evidence_grade_note: Evidence grades are defined in Section 12.13 of the manuscript; a null grade marks rejected, retired, not-established, or commitment claims for which a scientific evidence grade is not asserted.
